quiz.q: Why was it called the Battle of the Cowshed?
o: The ambush was sprung from the cowshed

quiz.q: How does Boxer feel about the stable-lad he struck?
o: Sorrowful — he had no wish to take life

chapters.recap_uz: «Angliya hayvonlari» qishloqlar bo'ylab tarqaladi. Jons qo'shnilar bilan fermani qaytarib olishga keladi, lekin Snoubolning rejasi bilan hayvonlar g'alaba qiladi. Bokser bir bolani o'ldirib qo'ydim deb qayg'uradi. Snoubol va Bokser «Hayvon Qahramoni» bo'ladi.

chapters.title: Snowball's expulsion

paras.en: As winter drew on, Mollie became more and more troublesome. She was late for work every morning and excused herself by saying that she had overslept, and she complained of mysterious pains, although her appetite was excellent. On every kind of pretext she would run away from work and go to the drinking pool, where she would stand foolishly gazing at her own reflection in the water. But there were also rumours of something more serious. One day, as Mollie strolled blithely into the yard, flirting her long tail and chewing at a stalk of hay, Clover took her aside.
paras.uz: Qish yaqinlashgani sari Molli tobora ko'proq tashvish keltira boshladi. U har kuni ertalab ishga kechikar va uxlab qolibman, deb uzr so'rardi, ishtahasi juda yaxshi bo'lishiga qaramay, sirli og'riqlardan shikoyat qilardi. Har xil bahona bilan ishdan qochib, sug'orish hovuziga borar va u yerda suvdagi o'z aksiga ahmoqona tikilib turardi. Lekin jiddiyroq narsa haqida ham mish-mishlar yurardi. Bir kuni Molli uzun dumini noz bilan silkitib, pichan poyasini chaynagancha beg'am hovliga kirib kelganda, Klover uni chetga tortdi.

paras.en: ‘Mollie,’ she said, ‘I have something very serious to say to you. This morning I saw you looking over the hedge that divides Animal Farm from Foxwood. One of Mr. Pilkington’s men was standing on the other side of the hedge. And – I was a long way away, but I am almost certain I saw this – he was talking to you and you were allowing him to stroke your nose. What does that mean, Mollie?’
paras.uz: «Molli, — dedi u, — senga juda jiddiy gapim bor. Bugun ertalab seni Hayvonlar fermasini Foksvuddan ajratib turadigan to'siq ustidan qarab turganingni ko'rdim. To'siqning narigi tomonida janob Pilkingtonning odamlaridan biri turgan edi. Va — men ancha uzoqda edim, lekin buni ko'rganimga deyarli aminman — u sen bilan gaplashayotgan edi, sen esa uning burningni silashiga yo'l qo'yayotgan eding. Bu nimani anglatadi, Molli?»

paras.en: ‘He didn’t! I wasn’t! It isn’t true!’ cried Mollie, beginning to prance about and paw the ground.
paras.uz: «U silamadi! Men yo'l qo'ymadim! Bu rost emas!» — deb qichqirdi Molli, sakrab-o'ynoqlab, yerni tuyog'i bilan tirnay boshlab.

paras.en: ‘Mollie! Look me in the face. Do you give me your word of honour that that man was not stroking your nose?’
paras.uz: «Molli! Yuzimga qara. Sharafing bilan so'z berasanmi, o'sha odam burningni silamaganiga?»

paras.en: ‘It isn’t true!’ repeated Mollie, but she could not look Clover in the face, and the next moment she took to her heels and galloped away into the field.
paras.uz: «Bu rost emas!» — deb takrorladi Molli, lekin Kloverning yuziga qaray olmadi va keyingi lahzada qochib, dalaga chopib ketdi.

paras.en: A thought struck Clover. Without saying anything to the others, she went to Mollie’s stall and turned over the straw with her hoof. Hidden under the straw was a little pile of lump sugar and several bunches of ribbon of different colours.
paras.uz: Kloverning xayoliga bir fikr keldi. Boshqalarga hech narsa demasdan, u Mollining qo'rasiga borib, tuyog'i bilan somonni ag'dardi. Somon ostida kichik bir uyum bo'lak qand va bir nechta turli rangdagi lenta dastalari yashirib qo'yilgan edi.

paras.en: Three days later Mollie disappeared. For some weeks nothing was known of her whereabouts, then the pigeons reported that they had seen her on the other side of Willingdon. She was between the shafts of a smart dogcart painted red and black, which was standing outside a public-house. A fat red-faced man in check breeches and gaiters, who looked like a publican, was stroking her nose and feeding her with sugar. Her coat was newly clipped and she wore a scarlet ribbon round her forelock. She appeared to be enjoying herself, so the pigeons said. None of the animals ever mentioned Mollie again.
paras.uz: Uch kundan keyin Molli g'oyib bo'ldi. Bir necha hafta uning qayerdaligi haqida hech narsa ma'lum bo'lmadi, keyin kaptarlar uni Uillingdonning narigi tomonida ko'rganliklarini xabar qilishdi. U qizil va qora rangga bo'yalgan chiroyli ikki g'ildirakli aravaning tortqisiga qo'shilgan holda bir qovoqxona oldida turgan ekan. Qovoqxona egasiga o'xshagan, katak shim va gamashi kiygan, qizil yuzli semiz bir odam uning burnini silab, qand bilan siylayotgan ekan. Uning yungi yangi qirqilgan, peshona yoliga qip-qizil lenta taqilgan edi. Kaptarlarning aytishicha, u o'zidan juda mamnun ko'rinardi. Hayvonlarning hech biri Mollini boshqa hech qachon tilga olmadi.

paras.en: In January there came bitterly hard weather. The earth was like iron, and nothing could be done in the fields. Many meetings were held in the big barn, and the pigs occupied themselves with planning out the work of the coming season. It had come to be accepted that the pigs, who were manifestly cleverer than the other animals, should decide all questions of farm policy, though their decisions had to be ratified by a majority vote. This arrangement would have worked well enough if it had not been for the disputes between Snowball and Napoleon. These two disagreed at every point where disagreement was possible.
paras.uz: Yanvarda qahraton sovuqlar boshlandi. Yer temirdek qotib qoldi, dalalarda hech narsa qilib bo'lmasdi. Katta molxonada ko'p yig'ilishlar o'tkazildi, cho'chqalar esa kelgusi mavsum ishlarini rejalashtirish bilan band bo'lishdi. Boshqa hayvonlardan ochiq-oydin aqlliroq bo'lgan cho'chqalar ferma siyosatiga oid barcha masalalarni hal qilishi kerakligi qabul qilingan holga aylangan edi, garchi ularning qarorlari ko'pchilik ovozi bilan tasdiqlanishi kerak bo'lsa ham. Agar Snoubol va Napoleon o'rtasidagi bahslar bo'lmaganida, bu tartib yetarlicha yaxshi ishlagan bo'lardi. Bu ikkovi kelishmovchilik bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan har bir nuqtada kelisha olmasdi.

paras.en: If one of them suggested sowing a bigger acreage with barley, the other was certain to demand a bigger acreage of oats, and if one of them said that such and such a field was just right for cabbages, the other would declare that it was useless for anything except roots. Each had his own following, and there were some violent debates. At the Meetings Snowball often won over the majority by his brilliant speeches, but Napoleon was better at canvassing support for himself in between times. He was especially successful with the sheep. Of late the sheep had taken to bleating ‘Four legs good, two legs bad’ both in and out of season, and they often interrupted the Meeting with this. It was noticed that they were especially liable to break into ‘Four legs good, two legs bad’ at crucial moments in Snowball’s speeches.
paras.uz: Agar biri arpaga kattaroq maydon ekishni taklif qilsa, ikkinchisi albatta sulining maydonini kattalashtirishni talab qilardi, va agar biri falon dala karam uchun ayni muddao desa, ikkinchisi u ildizmevalardan boshqa hech narsaga yaramaydi, deb e'lon qilardi. Har birining o'z tarafdorlari bor edi va ba'zan juda qizg'in bahslar bo'lardi. Yig'ilishlarda Snoubol ko'pincha ajoyib nutqlari bilan ko'pchilikni o'z tomoniga og'dirardi, lekin Napoleon yig'ilishlar oralig'ida o'ziga qo'llab-quvvatlash to'plashda ustaroq edi. U ayniqsa qo'ylar orasida muvaffaqiyat qozongan edi. Oxirgi paytlarda qo'ylar o'rinli-o'rinsiz «To'rt oyoq — yaxshi, ikki oyoq — yomon» deb ma'rashni odat qilib olgan edi va bu bilan ko'pincha Yig'ilishni bo'lib qo'yishardi. Ular ayniqsa Snoubol nutqlarining hal qiluvchi lahzalarida «To'rt oyoq — yaxshi, ikki oyoq — yomon» deb ma'rab yuborishga moyil ekani payqaldi.

paras.en: Snowball had made a close study of some back numbers of the Farmer and Stock-breeder which he had found in the farmhouse, and was full of plans for innovations and improvements. He talked learnedly about field-drains, silage and basic slag, and had worked out a complicated scheme for all the animals to drop their dung directly in the fields, at a different spot every day, to save the labour of cartage. Napoleon produced no schemes of his own, but said quietly that Snowball's would come to nothing, and seemed to be biding his time. But of all their controversies, none was so bitter as the one that took place over the windmill.
paras.uz: Snoubol ferma uyidan topgan «Fermer va chorvador» jurnalining eski sonlarini puxta o'rganib chiqqan va yangiliklar va yaxshilanishlar rejalariga to'la edi. U dala zovurlari, silos va fosforli shlak haqida olimona gapirar, tashish mehnatini tejash uchun barcha hayvonlar go'ngini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri dalalarga, har kuni boshqa joyga tashlashi haqidagi murakkab sxemani ishlab chiqqan edi. Napoleon o'zining hech qanday sxemasini taklif qilmadi, lekin Snoubolnikidan hech narsa chiqmaydi, deb jimgina aytib qo'yar va go'yo o'z vaqtini kutayotgandek edi. Lekin ularning barcha bahslari orasida hech biri shamol tegirmoni haqidagi bahsdek achchiq bo'lmadi.

paras.en: In the long pasture, not far from the farm buildings, there was a small knoll which was the highest point on the farm. After surveying the ground Snowball declared that this was just the place for a windmill, which could be made to operate a dynamo and supply the farm with electrical power. This would light the stalls and warm them in winter, and would also run a circular saw, a chaff-cutter, a mangel-slicer and an electric milking machine. The animals had never heard of anything of this kind before (for the farm was an old-fashioned one and had only the most primitive machinery), and they listened in astonishment while Snowball conjured up pictures of fantastic machines which would do their work for them while they grazed at their ease in the fields or improved their minds with reading and conversation.
paras.uz: Ferma binolaridan unchalik uzoq bo'lmagan uzun yaylovda fermaning eng baland nuqtasi bo'lgan kichik tepalik bor edi. Yerni ko'zdan kechirgach, Snoubol bu shamol tegirmoni uchun ayni joy, uni dinamoni harakatlantirib, fermani elektr energiyasi bilan ta'minlaydigan qilish mumkin, deb e'lon qildi. Bu qo'ralarni yoritib, qishda isitadi, shuningdek, dumaloq arra, somon to'g'ragich, lavlagi kesgich va elektr sog'ish mashinasini ham ishlatadi. Hayvonlar ilgari bunday narsa haqida hech qachon eshitmagan edi (chunki ferma eski usuldagi bo'lib, unda faqat eng ibtidoiy mashinalar bor edi), va Snoubol ular dalalarda bemalol o't yeb yurganda yoki o'qish va suhbat bilan aqllarini o'stirib turganda ularning ishini qiladigan ajoyib mashinalar manzarasini chizib berarkan, ular hayratda tinglashardi.

paras.en: Within a few weeks Snowball's plans for the windmill were fully worked out. The mechanical details came mostly from three books which had belonged to Mr Jones – One Thousand Useful Things to Do About the House, Every Man His Own Bricklayer, and Electricity for Beginners. Snowball used as his study a shed which had once been used for incubators and had a smooth wooden floor, suitable for drawing on. He was closeted there for hours at a time. With his books held open by a stone, and with a piece of chalk gripped between the knuckles of his trotter, he would move rapidly to and fro, drawing in line after line and uttering little whimpers of excitement. Gradually the plans grew into a complicated mass of cranks and cog-wheels, covering more than half the floor, which the other animals found completely unintelligible but very impressive.
paras.uz: Bir necha hafta ichida Snoubolning shamol tegirmoni rejalari to'liq ishlab chiqildi. Mexanik tafsilotlar asosan janob Jonsga tegishli bo'lgan uchta kitobdan olingan edi — «Uy atrofida qilish mumkin bo'lgan ming foydali ish», «Har kim o'zining g'ishtteruvchisi» va «Boshlovchilar uchun elektr». Snoubol ish xonasi sifatida bir vaqtlar inkubatorlar uchun ishlatilgan, chizishga qulay silliq yog'och polli shiyponni tanladi. U u yerda soatlab qamalib o'tirardi. Kitoblarini tosh bilan ochiq holda bosib qo'yib, tuyog'ining bo'g'imlari orasida bir bo'lak bo'r qisgancha, u tez-tez u yoqdan-bu yoqqa yurar, chiziq ustiga chiziq tortar va hayajondan ingichka ingrab qo'yardi. Asta-sekin chizmalar polning yarmidan ko'pini egallagan tirsakli vallar va tishli g'ildiraklarning murakkab to'plamiga aylandi, boshqa hayvonlar ularni mutlaqo tushunishmasdi, lekin ular juda ta'sirli ko'rinardi.

paras.en: All of them came to look at Snowball's drawings at least once a day. Even the hens and ducks came, and were at pains not to tread on the chalk marks. Only Napoleon held aloof. He had declared himself against the windmill from the start. One day, however, he arrived unexpectedly to examine the plans. He walked heavily round the shed, looked closely at every detail of the plans and snuffed at them once or twice, then stood for a little while contemplating them out of the corner of his eye; then suddenly he lifted his leg, urinated over the plans and walked out without uttering a word.
paras.uz: Hammalari kuniga kamida bir marta Snoubolning chizmalarini ko'rgani kelishardi. Hatto tovuqlar va o'rdaklar ham kelib, bo'r izlarini bosib qo'ymaslikka harakat qilishardi. Faqat Napoleon chetda turdi. U boshidanoq shamol tegirmoniga qarshi ekanini e'lon qilgan edi. Biroq bir kuni u kutilmaganda chizmalarni ko'zdan kechirish uchun keldi. U shiypon bo'ylab og'ir-og'ir aylanib, chizmalarning har bir tafsilotiga diqqat bilan qaradi, bir-ikki marta ularni hidlab ko'rdi, keyin biroz vaqt ko'z qiri bilan ularga tikilib turdi; so'ngra birdan oyog'ini ko'tarib, chizmalar ustiga siydi va bir og'iz ham gapirmasdan chiqib ketdi.

paras.en: The whole farm was deeply divided on the subject of the windmill. Snowball did not deny that to build it would be a difficult business. Stone would have to be quarried and built up into walls, then the sails would have to be made and after that there would be need for dynamos and cables. (How these were to be procured Snowball did not say.) But he maintained that it could all be done in a year. And thereafter, he declared, so much labour would be saved that the animals would only need to work three days a week. Napoleon, on the other hand, argued that the great need of the moment was to increase food production, and that if they wasted time on the windmill they would all starve to death.
paras.uz: Shamol tegirmoni masalasida butun ferma chuqur ikkiga bo'lindi. Snoubol uni qurish qiyin ish ekanini inkor etmadi. Toshni kon qilib qazib olib, devor qilib terish kerak bo'ladi, keyin qanotlarini yasash kerak, undan keyin esa dinamolar va kabellar kerak bo'ladi. (Bularni qanday qo'lga kiritish haqida Snoubol hech narsa demadi.) Lekin u hammasini bir yilda qilish mumkinligini ta'kidladi. Shundan keyin, deb e'lon qildi u, shunchalik ko'p mehnat tejaladiki, hayvonlar haftada faqat uch kun ishlashlari kerak bo'ladi. Napoleon esa, aksincha, hozirgi paytdagi eng katta ehtiyoj oziq-ovqat ishlab chiqarishni ko'paytirish ekanini, agar shamol tegirmoniga vaqt sarflasalar, hammalari ochdan o'lishlarini ta'kidladi.

paras.en: The animals formed themselves into two factions under the slogans, ‘Vote for Snowball and the three-day week’ and ‘Vote for Napoleon and the full manger.’ Benjamin was the only animal who did not side with either faction. He refused to believe either that food would become more plentiful or that the windmill would save work. Windmill or no windmill, he said, life would go on as it had always gone on – that is, badly.
paras.uz: Hayvonlar «Snoubolga va uch kunlik ish haftasiga ovoz bering» hamda «Napoleonga va to'la oxurga ovoz bering» shiorlari ostida ikki guruhga bo'linishdi. Benjamin hech bir guruh tomonini olmagan yagona hayvon edi. U ovqat ko'payishiga ham, shamol tegirmoni mehnatni tejashiga ham ishonishdan bosh tortdi. Shamol tegirmoni bo'ladimi yo'qmi, derdi u, hayot doim qanday kechgan bo'lsa, shunday kechaveradi — ya'ni yomon.

paras.en: Apart from the disputes over the windmill, there was the question of the defence of the farm. It was fully realised that though the human beings had been defeated in the Battle of the Cowshed they might make another and more determined attempt to recapture the farm and reinstate Mr Jones. They had all the more reason for doing so because the news of their defeat had spread across the countryside and made the animals on the neighbouring farms more restive than ever. As usual, Snowball and Napoleon were in disagreement. According to Napoleon, what the animals must do was to procure firearms and train themselves in the use of them. According to Snowball, they must send out more and more pigeons and stir up rebellion among the animals on the other farms. The one argued that if they could not defend themselves they were bound to be conquered, the other argued that if rebellions happened everywhere they would have no need to defend themselves. The animals listened first to Napoleon, then to Snowball, and could not make up their minds which was right; indeed they always found themselves in agreement with the one who was speaking at the moment.
paras.uz: Shamol tegirmoni haqidagi bahslardan tashqari, fermani himoya qilish masalasi ham bor edi. Insonlar Molxona jangida mag'lub bo'lgan bo'lsa ham, fermani qayta qo'lga olish va janob Jonsni joyiga tiklash uchun yana bir, qat'iyroq urinish qilishlari mumkinligi to'liq anglanardi. Ularda buning uchun yana ham ko'proq sabab bor edi, chunki mag'lubiyatlari haqidagi xabar qishloq bo'ylab tarqalib, qo'shni fermalardagi hayvonlarni har qachongidan ham bezovta qilib qo'ygan edi. Odatdagidek, Snoubol va Napoleon kelisha olmadilar. Napoleonning fikricha, hayvonlar o'qotar qurol topib, uni ishlatishni o'rganishlari kerak edi. Snoubolning fikricha esa, ular tobora ko'proq kaptar jo'natib, boshqa fermalardagi hayvonlar orasida qo'zg'olon ko'tarishlari kerak edi. Biri agar o'zlarini himoya qila olmasalar, albatta bosib olinishlarini ta'kidlasa, ikkinchisi agar hamma joyda qo'zg'olonlar bo'lsa, o'zlarini himoya qilishga hojat qolmasligini ta'kidlardi. Hayvonlar avval Napoleonni, keyin Snoubolni tinglashdi va qaysi biri haq ekanini hal qila olishmadi; aslida ular doim o'sha paytda gapirayotgan bilan rozi bo'lib qolishardi.

paras.en: At last the day came when Snowball's plans were completed. At the Meeting on the following Sunday the question of whether or not to begin work on the windmill was to be put to the vote. When the animals had assembled in the big barn, Snowball stood up and, though occasionally interrupted by bleating from the sheep, set forth his reasons for advocating the building of the windmill. Then Napoleon stood up to reply. He said very quietly that the windmill was nonsense and that he advised nobody to vote for it, and promptly sat down again; he had spoken for barely thirty seconds, and seemed almost indifferent as to the effect he produced. At this Snowball sprang to his feet, and shouting down the sheep, who had begun bleating again, broke into a passionate appeal in favour of the windmill.
paras.uz: Nihoyat Snoubolning rejalari tugallangan kun keldi. Keyingi yakshanbadagi Yig'ilishda shamol tegirmonini qurishni boshlash yoki boshlamaslik masalasi ovozga qo'yilishi kerak edi. Hayvonlar katta molxonaga yig'ilgach, Snoubol o'rnidan turdi va qo'ylarning ma'rashi vaqti-vaqti bilan bo'lib qo'yganiga qaramay, shamol tegirmonini qurish tarafdori bo'lishining sabablarini bayon qildi. Keyin javob berish uchun Napoleon o'rnidan turdi. U juda jimgina shamol tegirmoni bema'nilik ekanini va hech kimga unga ovoz berishni maslahat bermasligini aytdi-da, darhol yana o'tirdi; u zo'rg'a o'ttiz soniya gapirdi va qanday taassurot qoldirganiga deyarli befarq ko'rinardi. Shunda Snoubol sakrab o'rnidan turdi va yana ma'ray boshlagan qo'ylarni baqirib bosib, shamol tegirmoni foydasiga ehtirosli murojaat bilan chiqdi.

paras.en: Until now the animals had been about equally divided in their sympathies, but in a moment Snowball's eloquence had carried them away. In glowing sentences he painted a picture of Animal Farm as it might be when sordid labour was lifted from the animals’ backs. His imagination had now run far beyond chaff-cutters and turnip-slicers. Electricity, he said, could operate threshing-machines, ploughs, harrows, rollers and reapers and binders, besides supplying every stall with its own electric light, hot and cold water and an electric heater. By the time he had finished speaking there was no doubt as to which way the vote would go. But just at this moment Napoleon stood up and, casting a peculiar sidelong look at Snowball, uttered a high-pitched whimper of a kind no one had ever heard him utter before.
paras.uz: Shu paytgacha hayvonlarning xayrixohligi taxminan teng bo'lingan edi, lekin bir lahzada Snoubolning notiqligi ularni o'ziga rom etdi. Yorqin jumlalar bilan u hayvonlarning yelkasidan iflos mehnat olib tashlangandagi Hayvonlar fermasining qanday bo'lishi mumkinligi manzarasini chizdi. Uning tasavvuri endi somon to'g'ragichlar va sholg'om kesgichlardan ancha uzoqqa ketgan edi. Elektr, dedi u, har bir qo'rani o'z elektr chirog'i, issiq va sovuq suvi va elektr isitgichi bilan ta'minlashdan tashqari, xirmon mashinalarini, omochlarni, boronalarni, g'altaklarni, o'rish va bog'lash mashinalarini ham ishlata oladi. U gapini tugatganda ovoz qaysi tomonga ketishiga hech qanday shubha qolmagan edi. Lekin aynan shu lahzada Napoleon o'rnidan turdi va Snoubolga g'alati bir qiyshiq nazar tashlab, ilgari hech kim undan eshitmagan ingichka chiyillash chiqardi.

paras.en: At this there was a terrible baying sound outside, and nine enormous dogs wearing brass-studded collars came bounding into the barn. They dashed straight for Snowball, who only sprang from his place just in time to escape their snapping jaws. In a moment he was out of the door and they were after him. Too amazed and frightened to speak, all the animals crowded through the door to watch the chase. Snowball was racing across the long pasture that led to the road. He was running as only a pig can run, but the dogs were close on his heels. Suddenly he slipped and it seemed certain that they had him. Then he was up again, running faster than ever, then the dogs were gaining on him again. One of them all but closed his jaws on Snowball's tail, but Snowball whisked it free just in time. Then he put on an extra spurt and, with a few inches to spare, slipped through a hole in the hedge and was seen no more.
paras.uz: Shunda tashqaridan dahshatli vovullash eshitildi va jez qubbali bo'yinbog' taqqan to'qqizta ulkan it sakrab molxonaga kirib keldi. Ular to'g'ri Snoubolga tashlanishdi, u esa ularning g'arsillab yopilayotgan jag'laridan qutulish uchun joyidan o'z vaqtida zo'rg'a sakrab qoldi. Bir lahzada u eshikdan chiqib ketdi, itlar esa uning ortidan. Gapirishga ham imkon bermaydigan darajada hayratda va qo'rquvda qolgan barcha hayvonlar quvg'inni tomosha qilish uchun eshikdan tiqilib chiqishdi. Snoubol yo'lga olib boradigan uzun yaylov bo'ylab chopib borardi. U faqat cho'chqa chopa oladigandek chopardi, lekin itlar uning izma-iz kelardi. Birdan u sirpanib ketdi va ular uni ushlab olishi aniq bo'lib tuyuldi. Keyin u yana turib, har qachongidan tezroq chopdi, keyin itlar yana unga yetib ola boshlashdi. Ulardan biri Snoubolning dumini tishlab olishiga sal qoldi, lekin Snoubol uni o'z vaqtida tortib oldi. So'ngra u yana bir zo'r berib, bir necha dyuym farq bilan to'siqdagi teshikdan sirg'alib o'tdi va boshqa ko'rinmadi.

paras.en: Silent and terrified, the animals crept back into the barn. In a moment the dogs came bounding back. At first no one had been able to imagine where these creatures came from, but the problem was soon solved: they were the puppies whom Napoleon had taken away from their mothers and reared privately. Though not yet full-grown they were huge dogs, and as fierce-looking as wolves. They kept close to Napoleon. It was noticed that they wagged their tails to him in the same way as the other dogs had been used to do to Mr Jones.
paras.uz: Jim va qo'rquvga tushgan hayvonlar molxonaga sudralib qaytishdi. Bir lahzadan keyin itlar sakrab qaytib kelishdi. Dastlab bu jonivorlar qayerdan kelganini hech kim tasavvur qila olmadi, lekin jumboq tez yechildi: bular Napoleon onalaridan olib, yashirincha boqqan kuchukchalar edi. Hali to'liq voyaga yetmagan bo'lsalar ham, ular ulkan va bo'rilardek yovuz ko'rinishli itlar edi. Ular Napoleonning yonidan jilmasdi. Boshqa itlar ilgari janob Jonsga qanday dum likillatgan bo'lsa, bular ham Napoleonga xuddi shunday dum likillatishi payqaldi.

paras.en: Napoleon, with the dogs following him, now mounted onto the raised portion of the floor where Major had previously stood to deliver his speech. He announced that from now on the Sunday-morning Meetings would come to an end. They were unnecessary, he said, and wasted time. In future all questions relating to the working of the farm would be settled by a special committee of pigs, presided over by himself. These would meet in private and afterwards communicate their decisions to the others. The animals would still assemble on Sunday mornings to salute the flag, sing ‘Beasts of England’ and receive their orders for the week; but there would be no more debates.
paras.uz: Endi Napoleon, orqasidan itlar ergashgan holda, polning ilgari Mayor nutq so'zlash uchun turgan baland qismiga chiqdi. U bundan buyon yakshanba ertalabki Yig'ilishlar to'xtatilishini e'lon qildi. Ular keraksiz va vaqtni behuda o'tkazadi, dedi u. Kelajakda fermaning ishiga oid barcha masalalar uning o'zi raislik qiladigan cho'chqalarning maxsus qo'mitasi tomonidan hal qilinadi. Ular yopiq yig'ilishlar o'tkazib, keyin qarorlarini boshqalarga yetkazadi. Hayvonlar yakshanba ertalab bayroqqa salom berish, «Angliya hayvonlari»ni kuylash va hafta uchun buyruqlarni olish uchun hali ham yig'ilishadi; lekin endi munozaralar bo'lmaydi.

paras.en: In spite of the shock that Snowball's expulsion had given them, the animals were dismayed by this announcement. Several of them would have protested if they could have found the right arguments. Even Boxer was vaguely troubled. He set his ears back, shook his forelock several times, and tried hard to marshal his thoughts; but in the end he could not think of anything to say. Some of the pigs themselves, however, were more articulate. Four young porkers in the front row uttered shrill squeals of disapproval, and all four of them sprang to their feet and began speaking at once. But suddenly the dogs sitting round Napoleon let out deep, menacing growls, and the pigs fell silent and sat down again. Then the sheep broke out into a tremendous bleating of ‘Four legs good, two legs bad!’ which went on for nearly a quarter of an hour and put an end to any chance of discussion.
paras.uz: Snoubolning haydalishi ularga bergan zarbaga qaramay, hayvonlar bu e'londan dovdirab qolishdi. Agar to'g'ri dalillarni topa olganlarida, ulardan bir nechtasi norozilik bildirgan bo'lardi. Hatto Bokser ham noaniq bezovtalandi. U quloqlarini orqaga qayirdi, peshona yolini bir necha marta silkitdi va fikrlarini tartibga solishga qattiq urindi; lekin oxir-oqibat aytadigan hech narsa topa olmadi. Biroq cho'chqalarning o'zlaridan ba'zilari gapga chechanroq edi. Oldingi qatordagi to'rtta yosh cho'chqa norozilik bildirib chiyillab yuborishdi va to'rttalasi ham sakrab o'rnidan turib, birdaniga gapira boshlashdi. Lekin birdan Napoleon atrofida o'tirgan itlar chuqur, tahdidli irillashdi va cho'chqalar jim bo'lib, yana o'tirishdi. Keyin qo'ylar dahshatli ovozda «To'rt oyoq — yaxshi, ikki oyoq — yomon!» deb ma'rashni boshlab yuborishdi, bu deyarli chorak soat davom etdi va muhokamaning har qanday imkoniyatiga chek qo'ydi.

paras.en: Afterwards Squealer was sent round the farm to explain the new arrangement to the others.
paras.uz: Keyin yangi tartibni boshqalarga tushuntirish uchun Skviler ferma bo'ylab yuborildi.

paras.en: ‘Comrades,’ he said, ‘I trust that every animal here appreciates the sacrifice that Comrade Napoleon has made in taking this extra labour upon himself. Do not imagine, comrades, that leadership is a pleasure! On the contrary, it is a deep and heavy responsibility. No one believes more firmly than Comrade Napoleon that all animals are equal. He would be only too happy to let you make your decisions for yourselves. But sometimes you might make the wrong decisions, comrades, and then where should we be? Suppose you had decided to follow Snowball, with his moonshine of windmills – Snowball, who, as we now know, was no better than a criminal?’
paras.uz: «O'rtoqlar, — dedi u, — ishonamanki, bu yerdagi har bir hayvon O'rtoq Napoleonning bu qo'shimcha mehnatni o'z zimmasiga olib qilgan qurbonligini qadrlaydi. O'rtoqlar, rahbarlik zavq deb o'ylamang! Aksincha, bu chuqur va og'ir mas'uliyat. Barcha hayvonlar teng ekaniga O'rtoq Napoleondan ko'ra qattiqroq ishonadigan hech kim yo'q. U qarorlarni o'zingiz qabul qilishingizga yo'l qo'yishdan juda xursand bo'lardi. Lekin ba'zan noto'g'ri qaror qabul qilishingiz mumkin, o'rtoqlar, unda biz qayerda bo'lardik? Tasavvur qiling, siz shamol tegirmonlari haqidagi xom xayollari bilan Snoubolga ergashishga qaror qilganingizda — hozir bilib turganimizdek, jinoyatchidan yaxshi bo'lmagan Snoubolga?»

paras.en: ‘He fought bravely at the Battle of the Cowshed,’ said somebody.
paras.uz: «U Molxona jangida jasorat bilan jang qilgan edi», — dedi kimdir.

paras.en: ‘Bravery is not enough,’ said Squealer. ‘Loyalty and obedience are more important. And as to the Battle of the Cowshed, I believe the time will come when we shall find that Snowball's part in it was much exaggerated. Discipline, comrades, iron discipline! That is the watchword for today. One false step, and our enemies would be upon us. Surely, comrades, you do not want Jones back?’
paras.uz: «Jasorat yetarli emas, — dedi Skviler. — Sadoqat va itoat muhimroq. Molxona jangiga kelsak, ishonamanki, Snoubolning undagi roli juda bo'rttirilganini bilib oladigan vaqt keladi. Intizom, o'rtoqlar, temir intizom! Bugungi shior shu. Bitta noto'g'ri qadam — va dushmanlarimiz ustimizga bostirib keladi. Axir, o'rtoqlar, Jonsning qaytib kelishini istamaysizlar-ku?»

paras.en: Once again this argument was unanswerable. Certainly the animals did not want Jones back; if the holding of debates on Sunday mornings was liable to bring him back, then the debates must stop. Boxer, who had now had time to think things over, voiced the general feeling by saying:
paras.uz: Yana bir bor bu dalilga javob topib bo'lmasdi. Albatta, hayvonlar Jonsning qaytishini istamasdi; agar yakshanba ertalabki munozaralar uni qaytarib olib kelishi mumkin bo'lsa, unda munozaralar to'xtatilishi kerak edi. Endi o'ylab ko'rishga vaqt topgan Bokser umumiy fikrni shunday ifoda etdi:

paras.en: ‘If Comrade Napoleon says it, it must be right.’ And from then on he adopted the maxim, ‘Napoleon is always right,’ in addition to his private motto of ‘I will work harder’.
paras.uz: «Agar O'rtoq Napoleon shunday desa, demak to'g'ri.» Va o'sha paytdan boshlab u o'zining shaxsiy «Men yanada ko'proq ishlayman» shioriga qo'shimcha ravishda «Napoleon har doim haq» degan hikmatni qabul qildi.

paras.en: By this time the weather had broken and the spring ploughing had begun. The shed where Snowball had drawn his plans of the windmill had been shut up and it was assumed that the plans had been rubbed off the floor. Every Sunday morning at ten o'clock the animals assembled in the big barn to receive their orders for the week. The skull of old Major, now clean of flesh, had been disinterred from the orchard and set up on a stump at the foot of the flagstaff, beside the gun. After the hoisting of the flag the animals were required to file past the skull in a reverent manner before entering the barn. Nowadays they did not sit all together as they had done in the past.
paras.uz: Bu vaqtga kelib havo isib, bahorgi shudgor boshlangan edi. Snoubol shamol tegirmoni rejalarini chizgan shiypon yopib qo'yilgan va chizmalar poldan o'chirib tashlangan deb taxmin qilinardi. Har yakshanba ertalab soat o'nda hayvonlar hafta uchun buyruqlarni olish uchun katta molxonaga yig'ilishardi. Endi go'shtdan tozalangan keksa Mayorning bosh suyagi bog'dan qazib olinib, bayroq ustunining tagida, miltiq yonida to'nka ustiga o'rnatilgan edi. Bayroq ko'tarilgandan keyin hayvonlar molxonaga kirishdan oldin bosh suyagining yonidan ehtirom bilan bir qatorda o'tishlari shart edi. Endi ular avvalgidek hammasi birga o'tirishmasdi.

paras.en: Napoleon, with Squealer and another pig named Minimus, who had a remarkable gift for composing songs and poems, sat on the front of the raised platform, with the nine young dogs forming a semicircle round them, and the other pigs sitting behind. The rest of the animals sat facing them in the main body of the barn. Napoleon read out the orders for the week in a gruff soldierly style, and after a single singing of ‘Beasts of England’ all the animals dispersed.
paras.uz: Napoleon, Skviler va qo'shiq va she'rlar to'qishda ajoyib iste'dodga ega bo'lgan Minimus ismli boshqa bir cho'chqa bilan birga baland supaning old qismida o'tirardi, to'qqizta yosh it ularning atrofida yarim aylana hosil qilib turardi, boshqa cho'chqalar esa orqada o'tirardi. Qolgan hayvonlar molxonaning asosiy qismida ularga yuzma-yuz o'tirishardi. Napoleon hafta uchun buyruqlarni qo'pol askarcha uslubda o'qib berar va «Angliya hayvonlari» bir marta kuylangach, barcha hayvonlar tarqalishardi.

paras.en: On the third Sunday after Snowball's expulsion, the animals were somewhat surprised to hear Napoleon announce that the windmill was to be built after all. He did not give any reason for having changed his mind, but merely warned the animals that this extra task would mean very hard work; it might even be necessary to reduce their rations. The plans, however, had all been prepared, down to the last detail. A special committee of pigs had been at work upon them for the past three weeks. The building of the windmill, with various other improvements, was expected to take two years.
paras.uz: Snoubol haydalganidan keyingi uchinchi yakshanbada hayvonlar Napoleonning shamol tegirmoni baribir quriladi, deb e'lon qilganini eshitib, biroz hayron qolishdi. U fikrini o'zgartirganining hech qanday sababini aytmadi, faqat hayvonlarni bu qo'shimcha vazifa juda og'ir mehnatni talab qilishi haqida ogohlantirdi; hatto ulushlarini kamaytirish ham kerak bo'lishi mumkin edi. Biroq rejalar eng so'nggi tafsilotigacha tayyorlab qo'yilgan edi. Cho'chqalarning maxsus qo'mitasi o'tgan uch hafta davomida ular ustida ishlagan ekan. Shamol tegirmoni va boshqa turli yaxshilanishlarni qurish ikki yil davom etishi kutilardi.

paras.en: That evening Squealer explained privately to the other animals that Napoleon had never in reality been opposed to the windmill. On the contrary, it was he who had advocated it in the beginning, and the plan which Snowball had drawn on the floor of the incubator shed had actually been stolen from among Napoleon's papers. The windmill was, in fact, Napoleon's own creation. Why, then, asked somebody, had he spoken so strongly against it? Here Squealer looked very sly. That, he said, was Comrade Napoleon's cunning. He had seemed to oppose the windmill, simply as a manoeuvre to get rid of Snowball, who was a dangerous character and a bad influence. Now that Snowball was out of the way the plan could go forward without his interference. This, said Squealer, was something called tactics. He repeated a number of times, ‘Tactics, comrades, tactics!’ skipping round and whisking his tail with a merry laugh. The animals were not certain what the word meant, but Squealer spoke so persuasively, and the three dogs who happened to be with him growled so threateningly, that they accepted his explanation without further questions.
paras.uz: O'sha kuni kechqurun Skviler boshqa hayvonlarga xufyona tushuntirdiki, Napoleon aslida hech qachon shamol tegirmoniga qarshi bo'lmagan. Aksincha, boshida uni taklif qilgan uning o'zi bo'lgan, Snoubol inkubator shiyponining poliga chizgan reja esa aslida Napoleonning qog'ozlari orasidan o'g'irlangan ekan. Shamol tegirmoni, aslida, Napoleonning o'z ijodi ekan. Unda nega, deb so'radi kimdir, u unga qarshi shunchalik qattiq gapirdi? Shu yerda Skviler juda ayyor qiyofaga kirdi. Bu, dedi u, O'rtoq Napoleonning ustaligi edi. U shunchaki xavfli shaxs va yomon ta'sir manbai bo'lgan Snouboldan qutulish uchun manevr sifatida shamol tegirmoniga qarshidek ko'ringan. Endi Snoubol yo'ldan olib tashlangach, reja uning aralashuvisiz oldinga siljishi mumkin. Bu, dedi Skviler, taktika deb ataladigan narsa. U quvnoq kulib, aylanib sakrab va dumini silkitib, bir necha marta takrorladi: «Taktika, o'rtoqlar, taktika!» Hayvonlar bu so'z nimani anglatishini aniq bilishmasdi, lekin Skviler shunchalik ishonarli gapirdi, yonida bo'lib qolgan uchta it esa shunchalik tahdidli irilladiki, ular uning izohini boshqa savollarsiz qabul qilishdi.

quiz.q: Who chases Snowball off the farm?
quiz.why_uz: Bular Napoleon onalaridan olib qo'ygan kuchukchalar edi.

quiz.q: What new maxim does Boxer adopt?
quiz.why_uz: U «Men yanada ko'proq ishlayman»ga qo'shimcha qilib oladi.

chapters.recap_uz: Molli fermadan qochadi. Snoubol va Napoleon har masalada, ayniqsa shamol tegirmoni bo'yicha bahslashadi. Ovoz berish arafasida Napoleonning to'qqizta iti Snoubolni haydab chiqaradi. Yig'ilishlar bekor qilinadi, keyin esa tegirmon «aslida Napoleonning g'oyasi» deb e'lon qilinadi.

chapters.title: The windmill falls

paras.en: All that year the animals worked like slaves. But they were happy in their work; they grudged no effort or sacrifice, well aware that everything that they did was for the benefit of themselves and those of their kind who would come after them, and not for a pack of idle thieving human beings.
paras.uz: O'sha yil bo'yi hayvonlar quldek ishlashdi. Lekin ular o'z mehnatlaridan baxtli edi; ular hech qanday kuch yoki qurbonlikni ayamasdi, chunki qilayotgan har bir ishlari bir to'da dangasa o'g'ri insonlar uchun emas, balki o'zlari va o'zlaridan keyin keladigan jinsdoshlari foydasi uchun ekanini yaxshi bilishardi.

paras.en: Throughout the spring and summer they worked a sixty-hour week, and in August Napoleon announced that there would be work on Sunday afternoons as well. This work was strictly voluntary, but any animal who absented himself from it would have his rations reduced by half. Even so it was found necessary to leave certain tasks undone. The harvest was a little less successful than in the previous year, and two fields which should have been sown with roots in the early summer were not sown because the ploughing had not been completed early enough. It was possible to foresee that the coming winter would be a hard one.
paras.uz: Bahor va yoz bo'yi ular haftasiga oltmish soat ishlashdi, avgustda esa Napoleon yakshanba kunlari tushdan keyin ham ish bo'lishini e'lon qildi. Bu ish qat'iy ixtiyoriy edi, lekin undan qochgan har qanday hayvonning ulushi yarmiga kamaytirilardi. Shunday bo'lsa ham, ba'zi ishlarni bajarilmagan holda qoldirish kerak bo'ldi. Hosil o'tgan yilgidan biroz kamroq muvaffaqiyatli chiqdi, yoz boshida ildizmevalar ekilishi kerak bo'lgan ikki dala esa shudgor yetarlicha erta tugallanmagani uchun ekilmay qoldi. Kelgusi qish og'ir bo'lishini oldindan ko'rish mumkin edi.

paras.en: The windmill presented unexpected difficulties. There was a good quarry of limestone on the farm, and plenty of sand and cement had been found in one of the outhouses, so that all the materials for building were at hand. But the problem the animals could not at first solve was how to break up the stone into pieces of suitable size. There seemed no way of doing this except with picks and crowbars, which no animal could use, because no animal could stand on his hind legs. Only after weeks of vain effort did the right idea occur to somebody-namely, to utilise the force of gravity. Huge boulders, far too big to be used as they were, were lying all over the bed of the quarry.
paras.uz: Shamol tegirmoni kutilmagan qiyinchiliklarni keltirib chiqardi. Fermada yaxshi ohaktosh koni bor edi, xo'jalik binolaridan birida esa ko'p qum va sement topilgan edi, shuning uchun qurilish uchun barcha materiallar qo'l ostida edi. Lekin hayvonlar dastlab hal qila olmagan muammo toshni qanday qilib mos o'lchamdagi bo'laklarga bo'lish edi. Buni cho'kich va lomdan boshqa narsa bilan qilishning iloji yo'qdek tuyulardi, ularni esa hech bir hayvon ishlata olmasdi, chunki hech bir hayvon orqa oyoqlarida tura olmasdi. Faqat haftalab behuda urinishlardan keyingina kimningdir xayoliga to'g'ri fikr keldi — ya'ni og'irlik kuchidan foydalanish. Konning tubida o'z holicha ishlatish uchun juda katta bo'lgan ulkan xarsanglar sochilib yotardi.

paras.en: The animals lashed ropes round these, and then all together, cows, horses, sheep, any animal that could lay hold of the rope – even the pigs sometimes joined in at critical moments – they dragged them with desperate slowness up the slope to the top of the quarry, where they were toppled over the edge, to shatter to pieces below. Transporting the stone when it was once broken was comparatively simple. The horses carried it off in cartloads, the sheep dragged single blocks, even Muriel and Benjamin yoked themselves into an old governess-cart and did their share. By late summer a sufficient store of stone had accumulated, and then the building began, under the superintendence of the pigs.
paras.uz: Hayvonlar ularning atrofiga arqon bog'lashdi, keyin hammasi birgalikda — sigirlar, otlar, qo'ylar, arqondan ushlay oladigan har qanday hayvon — hatto cho'chqalar ham ba'zan hal qiluvchi lahzalarda qo'shilishardi — ularni umidsiz sekinlik bilan qiyalik bo'ylab kon tepasiga sudrab chiqishar, u yerda esa pastga qulab, chil-chil bo'lishi uchun chetdan itarib yuborishardi. Bir marta sindirilgan toshni tashish nisbatan oson edi. Otlar uni arava-arava qilib tashishdi, qo'ylar yakka-yakka bo'laklarni sudrashdi, hatto Muriel va Benjamin ham eski ikki g'ildirakli aravachaga qo'shilib, o'z hissalarini qo'shishdi. Yoz oxiriga kelib yetarli tosh zaxirasi to'plandi va keyin cho'chqalar nazorati ostida qurilish boshlandi.

paras.en: But it was a slow, laborious process. Frequently it took a whole day of exhausting effort to drag a single boulder to the top of the quarry, and sometimes when it was pushed over the edge it failed to break. Nothing could have been achieved without Boxer, whose strength seemed equal to that of all the rest of the animals put together. When the boulder began to slip and the animals cried out in despair at finding themselves dragged down the hill, it was always Boxer who strained himself against the rope and brought the boulder to a stop. To see him toiling up the slope inch by inch, his breath coming fast, the tips of his hoofs clawing at the ground and his great sides matted with sweat, filled everyone with admiration.
paras.uz: Lekin bu sekin, mashaqqatli jarayon edi. Ko'pincha bitta xarsangni kon tepasiga sudrab chiqish uchun butun bir kunlik holdan toydiruvchi mehnat ketardi, ba'zan esa uni chetdan itarishganda u sinmasdi. Kuchi qolgan barcha hayvonlarnikini qo'shganga teng bo'lib tuyulgan Boksersiz hech narsaga erishib bo'lmasdi. Xarsang sirpana boshlab, hayvonlar o'zlarini tepalikdan pastga sudralayotganini ko'rib umidsizlikdan qichqirganlarida, doim Bokser arqonni tarang tortib, xarsangni to'xtatardi. Uning nafasi tezlashgan, tuyoqlarining uchi yerga tirnalgan, ulkan biqinlari terdan namiqib, qiyalik bo'ylab dyuymma-dyuym ko'tarilayotganini ko'rish hammani hayratga solardi.

paras.en: Clover warned him sometimes to be careful not to overstrain himself, but Boxer would never listen to her. His two slogans, ‘I will work harder’ and ‘Napoleon is always right’, seemed to him a sufficient answer to all problems. He had made arrangements with the cockerel to call him three-quarters of an hour earlier in the mornings instead of half an hour. And in his spare moments, of which there were not many nowadays, he would go alone to the quarry, collect a load of broken stone and drag it down to the site of the windmill unassisted.
paras.uz: Klover ba'zan uni o'zini haddan tashqari zo'riqtirmaslikka ehtiyot bo'lishi haqida ogohlantirardi, lekin Bokser uni hech qachon tinglamasdi. Uning ikki shiori — «Men yanada ko'proq ishlayman» va «Napoleon har doim haq» — unga barcha muammolarga yetarli javob bo'lib tuyulardi. U xo'roz bilan kelishib, ertalab uni yarim soat emas, qirq besh daqiqa oldin uyg'otishni so'ragan edi. Hozirgi kunlarda unchalik ko'p bo'lmagan bo'sh vaqtlarida esa u yolg'iz o'zi konga borib, bir yuk singan tosh yig'ar va uni hech kimning yordamisiz shamol tegirmoni qurilayotgan joyga sudrab olib borardi.

paras.en: The animals were not badly off throughout that summer, in spite of the hardness of their work. If they had no more food than they had had in Jones's day, at least they did not have less. The advantage of only having to feed themselves, and not having to support five extravagant human beings as well, was so great that it would have taken a lot of failures to outweigh it. And in many ways the animal method of doing things was more efficient and saved labour. Such jobs as weeding, for instance, could be done with a thoroughness impossible to human beings. And again, since no animal now stole it was unnecessary to fence off pasture from arable land, which saved a lot of labour on the upkeep of hedges and gates. Nevertheless as the summer wore on various unforeseen shortages began to make themselves felt.
paras.uz: Mehnatlari og'ir bo'lishiga qaramay, o'sha yoz bo'yi hayvonlarning ahvoli yomon emas edi. Agar ularda Jons davridagidan ko'proq ovqat bo'lmagan bo'lsa ham, hech bo'lmasa kamroq ham emas edi. Faqat o'zlarini boqish va yana beshta isrofgar insonni boqmaslikning afzalligi shunchalik katta ediki, uni bosib ketishi uchun ko'p muvaffaqiyatsizliklar kerak bo'lardi. Ko'p jihatdan hayvonlarning ish usuli samaraliroq edi va mehnatni tejardi. Masalan, begona o'tlarni yulish kabi ishlarni insonlar uchun imkonsiz bo'lgan puxtalik bilan bajarish mumkin edi. Yana, endi hech bir hayvon o'g'irlik qilmagani uchun yaylovni ekin maydonidan to'siq bilan ajratishga hojat qolmadi, bu esa to'siqlar va darvozalarni ta'mirlashga ketadigan ko'p mehnatni tejadi. Shunga qaramay, yoz o'tgani sari turli kutilmagan tanqisliklar o'zini his ettira boshladi.

paras.en: There was need of paraffin oil, nails, string, dog biscuits and iron for the horses’ shoes, none of which could be produced on the farm. Later there would also be need for seeds and artificial manures, besides various tools and, finally, the machinery for the windmill. How these were to be procured no one was able to imagine.
paras.uz: Kerosin, mix, ip, it pechenyesi va otlarning taqasi uchun temir kerak edi, ularning hech birini fermada ishlab chiqarib bo'lmasdi. Keyinroq turli asboblar va nihoyat shamol tegirmoni uchun mashinalardan tashqari urug'lar va sun'iy o'g'itlar ham kerak bo'ladi. Bularni qanday qo'lga kiritish mumkinligini hech kim tasavvur qila olmasdi.

paras.en: One Sunday morning when the animals assembled to receive their orders Napoleon announced that he had decided upon a new policy. From now onwards Animal Farm would engage in trade with the neighbouring farms: not, of course, for any commercial purpose but simply in order to obtain certain materials which were urgently necessary. The needs of the windmill must override everything else, he said. He was therefore making arrangements to sell a stack of hay and part of the current year's wheat crop, and later on, if more money were needed, it would have to be made up by the sale of eggs, for which there was always a market in Willingdon. The hens, said Napoleon, should welcome this sacrifice as their own special contribution towards the building of the windmill.
paras.uz: Bir yakshanba ertalab hayvonlar buyruqlarni olish uchun yig'ilganda, Napoleon yangi siyosatga qaror qilganini e'lon qildi. Bundan buyon Hayvonlar fermasi qo'shni fermalar bilan savdo qiladi: albatta, hech qanday tijorat maqsadida emas, balki shunchaki shoshilinch zarur bo'lgan ba'zi materiallarni olish uchun. Shamol tegirmonining ehtiyojlari hamma narsadan ustun turishi kerak, dedi u. Shuning uchun u bir g'aram pichan va joriy yilgi bug'doy hosilining bir qismini sotishga tayyorgarlik ko'rmoqda, keyinroq, agar ko'proq pul kerak bo'lsa, uni Uillingdonda doim xaridori bo'ladigan tuxum sotish hisobiga to'ldirish kerak bo'ladi. Tovuqlar, dedi Napoleon, bu qurbonlikni shamol tegirmoni qurilishiga o'zlarining alohida hissasi sifatida mamnuniyat bilan qabul qilishlari kerak.

paras.en: Once again the animals were conscious of a vague uneasiness. Never to have any dealings with human beings, never to engage in trade, never to make use of money – had not these been among the earliest resolutions passed at that first triumphant Meeting after Jones was expelled? All the animals remembered passing such resolutions: or at least they thought that they remembered it. The four young pigs who had protested when Napoleon abolished the Meetings raised their voices timidly, but they were promptly silenced by a tremendous growling from the dogs. Then, as usual, the sheep broke into ‘Four legs good, two legs bad!’ and the momentary awkwardness was smoothed over. Finally Napoleon raised his trotter for silence and announced that he had already made all the arrangements.
paras.uz: Yana bir bor hayvonlar noaniq bezovtalikni his qilishdi. Insonlar bilan hech qachon hech qanday ish qilmaslik, hech qachon savdo bilan shug'ullanmaslik, hech qachon puldan foydalanmaslik — Jons haydalgandan keyingi o'sha birinchi g'alabali Yig'ilishda qabul qilingan eng dastlabki qarorlar qatorida bular ham yo'qmidi? Barcha hayvonlar bunday qarorlar qabul qilganlarini eslashardi: yoki hech bo'lmasa eslaymiz, deb o'ylashardi. Napoleon Yig'ilishlarni bekor qilganda norozilik bildirgan to'rtta yosh cho'chqa tortinibgina ovoz ko'tarishdi, lekin itlarning dahshatli irillashi ularni darhol jim qildi. Keyin odatdagidek qo'ylar «To'rt oyoq — yaxshi, ikki oyoq — yomon!» deb ma'rashni boshlab yuborishdi va bir lahzalik noqulaylik silliqlandi. Nihoyat Napoleon jimlik so'rab tuyog'ini ko'tardi va barcha tayyorgarliklarni allaqachon ko'rib qo'yganini e'lon qildi.

paras.en: There would be no need for any of the animals to come in contact with human beings, which would clearly be most undesirable. He intended to take the whole burden upon his own shoulders. A Mr Whymper, a solicitor living in Willingdon, had agreed to act as intermediary between Animal Farm and the outside world, and would visit the farm every Monday morning to receive his instructions. Napoleon ended his speech with his usual cry of ‘Long live Animal Farm!’, and after the singing of ‘Beasts of England’ the animals were dismissed.
paras.uz: Hayvonlarning hech biri insonlar bilan aloqa qilishiga hojat qolmaydi, bu esa ochiq-oydin juda nomaqbul bo'lardi. U butun yukni o'z yelkasiga olmoqchi edi. Uillingdonda yashovchi advokat janob Uimper Hayvonlar fermasi va tashqi dunyo o'rtasida vositachi bo'lishga rozi bo'lgan va ko'rsatmalar olish uchun har dushanba ertalab fermaga kelib turadi. Napoleon nutqini odatdagi «Yashasin Hayvonlar fermasi!» hayqirig'i bilan tugatdi va «Angliya hayvonlari» kuylangandan keyin hayvonlarga tarqalishga ruxsat berildi.

paras.en: Afterwards Squealer made a round of the farm and set the animals’ minds at rest. He assured them that the resolution against engaging in trade and using money had never been passed, or even suggested. It was pure imagination, probably traceable in the beginning to lies circulated by Snowball. A few animals still felt faintly doubtful, but Squealer asked them shrewdly, ‘Are you certain that this is not something that you have dreamed, comrades? Have you any record of such a resolution? Is it written down anywhere?’ And since it was certainly true that nothing of the kind existed in writing, the animals were satisfied that they had been mistaken.
paras.uz: Keyin Skviler ferma bo'ylab aylanib chiqib, hayvonlarning ko'nglini tinchlantirdi. U ularni savdo qilish va puldan foydalanishga qarshi qaror hech qachon qabul qilinmaganiga, hatto taklif ham qilinmaganiga ishontirdi. Bu sof xayol edi, ehtimol, boshida Snoubol tarqatgan yolg'onlardan kelib chiqqan. Bir nechta hayvon hali ham biroz shubhalanardi, lekin Skviler ulardan ayyorlik bilan so'radi: «Bu tushingizda ko'rgan narsa emasligiga aminmisiz, o'rtoqlar? Shunday qaror haqida sizda biror yozuv bormi? U biror joyda yozib qo'yilganmi?» Va bunday narsa hech qayerda yozma ravishda yo'qligi aniq rost bo'lgani uchun, hayvonlar o'zlari adashganlariga qanoat hosil qilishdi.

paras.en: Every Monday Mr Whymper visited the farm as had been arranged. He was a sly-looking little man with side whiskers, a solicitor in a very small way of business, but sharp enough to have realised earlier than anyone else that Animal Farm would need a broker and that the commissions would be worth having. The animals watched his coming and going with a kind of dread, and avoided him as much as possible. Nevertheless, the sight of Napoleon, on all fours, delivering orders to Whymper, who stood on two legs, roused their pride and partly reconciled them to the new arrangement. Their relations with the human race were now not quite the same as they had been before. The human beings did not hate Animal Farm any less now that it was prospering, indeed they hated it more than ever.
paras.uz: Har dushanba janob Uimper kelishilganidek fermaga kelardi. U chakka soqolli, ayyor ko'rinishli pakana odam, juda kichik miqyosda ish yurituvchi advokat edi, lekin Hayvonlar fermasiga dallol kerak bo'lishini va komissiya pullari arzirli ekanini hammadan oldin anglab yetadigan darajada o'tkir edi. Hayvonlar uning kelib-ketishini qandaydir qo'rquv bilan kuzatishar va iloji boricha undan qochishardi. Shunga qaramay, to'rt oyoqda turgan Napoleonning ikki oyoqda turgan Uimperga buyruq berayotganini ko'rish ularning g'ururini qo'zg'atar va ularni yangi tartib bilan qisman yarashtirardi. Ularning inson zoti bilan munosabatlari endi avvalgidek emas edi. Hayvonlar fermasi gullab-yashnayotgani uchun insonlar uni kamroq yomon ko'rishmasdi, aksincha, har qachongidan ham ko'proq nafratlanishardi.

paras.en: Every human being held it as an article of faith that the farm would go bankrupt sooner or later, and, above all, that the windmill would be a failure. They would meet in the public-houses and prove to one another by means of diagrams that the windmill was bound to fall down, or that if it did stand up, then that it would never work. And yet, against their will, they had developed a certain respect for the efficiency with which the animals were managing their own affairs. One symptom of this was that they had begun to call Animal Farm by its proper name and ceased to pretend that it was called the Manor Farm. They had also dropped their championship of Jones, who had given up hope of getting his farm back and gone to live in another part of the county.
paras.uz: Har bir inson ferma ertami-kechmi bankrot bo'lishini va, eng muhimi, shamol tegirmoni muvaffaqiyatsiz chiqishini e'tiqod sifatida qabul qilgan edi. Ular qovoqxonalarda uchrashib, bir-birlariga chizmalar yordamida shamol tegirmoni albatta qulashini yoki agar tursa ham, hech qachon ishlamasligini isbotlashardi. Shunga qaramay, istamasalar ham, hayvonlarning o'z ishlarini boshqarishdagi samaradorligiga nisbatan ularda ma'lum hurmat paydo bo'lgan edi. Buning bir belgisi shu ediki, ular Hayvonlar fermasini o'z nomi bilan atay boshlashdi va uni «Manor» fermasi deb atalgandek ko'rsatishni bas qilishdi. Ular fermasini qaytarib olishdan umidini uzib, grafligining boshqa bir joyiga yashashga ketgan Jonsni himoya qilishni ham tashlashdi.

paras.en: Except through Whymper there was as yet no contact between Animal Farm and the outside world, but there were constant rumours that Napoleon was about to enter into a definite business agreement either with Mr Pilkington of Foxwood or with Mr Frederick of Pinchfield – but never, it was noticed, with both simultaneously.
paras.uz: Uimperdan tashqari Hayvonlar fermasi va tashqi dunyo o'rtasida hali hech qanday aloqa yo'q edi, lekin Napoleon yo Foksvudlik janob Pilkington, yo Pinchfildlik janob Frederik bilan aniq tijorat kelishuviga kirishmoqchi ekani haqida doimiy mish-mishlar yurardi — lekin, payqalishicha, hech qachon ikkalasi bilan bir vaqtda emas.

paras.en: It was about this time that the pigs suddenly moved into the farmhouse and took up their residence there. Again the animals seemed to remember that a resolution against this had been passed in the early days, and again Squealer was able to convince them that this was not the case. It was absolutely necessary, he said, that the pigs, who were the brains of the farm, should have a quiet place to work in. It was also more suited to the dignity of the Leader (for of late he had taken to speaking of Napoleon under the title of ‘Leader’) to live in a house than in a mere sty. Nevertheless some of the animals were disturbed when they heard that the pigs not only took their meals in the kitchen and used the drawing-room as a recreation room, but also slept in the beds. Boxer passed it off as usual with ‘Napoleon is always right!’, but Clover, who thought she remembered a definite ruling against beds, went to the end of the barn and tried to puzzle out the Seven Commandments which were inscribed there. Finding herself unable to read more than individual letters, she fetched Muriel.
paras.uz: Taxminan shu vaqtda cho'chqalar birdan ferma uyiga ko'chib o'tib, u yerda yashay boshlashdi. Yana hayvonlar dastlabki kunlarda bunga qarshi qaror qabul qilinganini eslagandek bo'lishdi, va yana Skviler ularni bunday emasligiga ishontira oldi. Fermaning miyasi bo'lgan cho'chqalar ishlashi uchun tinch joy bo'lishi mutlaqo zarur, dedi u. Shuningdek, Dohiyning (chunki oxirgi paytlarda u Napoleon haqida «Dohiy» unvoni bilan gapiradigan bo'lgan edi) shunchaki cho'chqaxonada emas, uyda yashashi uning qadr-qimmatiga ko'proq mos edi. Shunga qaramay, cho'chqalar nafaqat oshxonada ovqatlanishi va mehmonxonani dam olish xonasi sifatida ishlatishi, balki karavotlarda ham uxlashini eshitib, ba'zi hayvonlar bezovtalanishdi. Bokser buni odatdagidek «Napoleon har doim haq!» deb o'tkazib yubordi, lekin karavotlarga qarshi aniq qoidani eslagandek bo'lgan Klover molxonaning oxiriga borib, u yerda yozilgan Yetti Amrni hijjalab o'qishga urindi. Alohida harflardan boshqasini o'qiy olmasligini ko'rib, u Murielni olib keldi.

paras.en: ‘Muriel,’ she said, ‘read me the Fourth Commandment. Does it not say something about never sleeping in a bed?’
paras.uz: «Muriel, — dedi u, — menga To'rtinchi Amrni o'qib ber. Unda karavotda hech qachon uxlamaslik haqida nimadir aytilmaganmi?»

paras.en: With some difficulty Muriel spelt it out.
paras.uz: Biroz qiynalib, Muriel uni hijjalab o'qidi.

paras.en: ‘It says, “No animal shall sleep in a bed with sheets”’ she announced finally.
paras.uz: «Unda «Hech bir hayvon choyshabli karavotda uxlamaydi» deyilgan», — deb e'lon qildi u nihoyat.

paras.en: Curiously enough, Clover had not remembered that the Fourth Commandment mentioned sheets; but as it was there on the wall, it must have done so. And Squealer, who happened to be passing at this moment, attended by two or three dogs, was able to put the whole matter in its proper perspective.
paras.uz: Qizig'i shundaki, Klover To'rtinchi Amrda choyshab tilga olinganini eslamagan edi; lekin devorda shunday yozilgani uchun, demak shunday bo'lgan. Ayni shu paytda ikki-uchta it hamrohligida o'tib ketayotgan Skviler butun masalani to'g'ri nuqtai nazardan tushuntirib bera oldi.

paras.en: ‘You have heard, then, comrades,’ he said, ‘that we pigs now sleep in the beds of the farmhouse? And why not? You did not suppose, surely, that there was ever a ruling against beds? A bed merely means a place to sleep in. A pile of straw in a stall is a bed, properly regarded. The rule was against sheets, which are a human invention. We have removed the sheets from the farmhouse beds, and sleep between blankets. And very comfortable beds they are too! But not more comfortable than we need, I can tell you, comrades, with all the brainwork we have to do nowadays. You would not rob us of our repose, would you, comrades? You would not have us too tired to carry out our duties? Surely none of you wishes to see Jones back?’
paras.uz: «Demak, o'rtoqlar, — dedi u, — biz cho'chqalar endi ferma uyining karavotlarida uxlashimizni eshitdingizmi? Nega endi yo'q? Axir karavotlarga qarshi hech qachon qoida bo'lgan deb o'ylamagandirsiz? Karavot shunchaki uxlaydigan joy degani. To'g'ri qaralganda, qo'radagi bir uyum somon ham karavot. Qoida inson ixtirosi bo'lgan choyshablarga qarshi edi. Biz ferma uyining karavotlaridan choyshablarni olib tashladik va adyollar orasida uxlaymiz. Juda qulay karavotlar ham! Lekin sizga aytib qo'yay, o'rtoqlar, hozirgi kunda qilishimiz kerak bo'lgan barcha aqliy mehnatimiz bilan, bizga kerak bo'lganidan qulayroq emas. Bizni orom-osoyishtaligimizdan mahrum qilmoqchi emassiz-ku, o'rtoqlar? Burchimizni bajara olmaydigan darajada charchashimizni istamaysiz-ku? Axir orangizda Jonsning qaytishini istaydigan hech kim yo'q-ku?»

paras.en: The animals reassured him on this point immediately, and no more was said about the pigs sleeping in the farmhouse beds. And when, some days afterwards, it was announced that from now on the pigs would get up an hour later in the mornings than the other animals, no complaint was made about that either.
paras.uz: Hayvonlar bu borada uni darhol ishontirishdi va cho'chqalarning ferma uyi karavotlarida uxlashi haqida boshqa gap bo'lmadi. Bir necha kundan keyin bundan buyon cho'chqalar ertalab boshqa hayvonlardan bir soat kech turishlari e'lon qilinganda ham, bu haqda hech qanday shikoyat bo'lmadi.

paras.en: By the autumn the animals were tired but happy. They had had a hard year, and after the sale of part of the hay and corn the stores of food for the winter were none too plentiful, but the windmill compensated for everything. It was almost half built now. After the harvest there was a stretch of clear dry weather, and the animals toiled harder than ever, thinking it well worth while to plod to and fro all day with blocks of stone if by doing so they could raise the walls another foot. Boxer would even come out at nights and work for an hour or two on his own by the light of the harvest moon. In their spare moments the animals would walk round and round the half-finished mill, admiring the strength and perpendicularity of its walls and marvelling that they should ever have been able to build anything so imposing. Only old Benjamin refused to grow enthusiastic about the windmill, though, as usual, he would utter nothing beyond the cryptic remark that donkeys live a long time.
paras.uz: Kuzga kelib hayvonlar charchagan, lekin baxtli edi. Ular og'ir yilni boshdan kechirishgan edi va pichan va donning bir qismi sotilgandan keyin qish uchun oziq-ovqat zaxiralari unchalik ko'p emas edi, lekin shamol tegirmoni hamma narsaning o'rnini qoplardi. U endi deyarli yarmigacha qurilgan edi. Hosildan keyin bir muddat ochiq, quruq havo bo'ldi va hayvonlar har qachongidan ham ko'proq mehnat qilishdi — agar shu bilan devorlarni yana bir fut ko'tara olsalar, kun bo'yi tosh bo'laklari bilan u yoqdan-bu yoqqa sudralib yurishga arziydi, deb o'ylashardi. Bokser hatto kechalari chiqib, o'rim oyi yorug'ida bir-ikki soat o'zicha ishlardi. Bo'sh vaqtlarida hayvonlar yarim qurilgan tegirmon atrofida aylanib yurishar, devorlarining mustahkamligi va tikligiga qoyil qolib, qachondir shunchalik salobatli narsani qura olganlaridan hayratlanishardi. Faqat keksa Benjamin shamol tegirmoniga ishtiyoq bildirishdan bosh tortdi, garchi odatdagidek eshaklar uzoq yashaydi, degan sirli gapdan nariga o'tmasa ham.

paras.en: November came, with raging south-west winds. Building had to stop because it was now too wet to mix the cement. Finally there came a night when the gale was so violent that the farm buildings rocked on their foundations and several tiles were blown off the roof of the barn. The hens woke up squawking with terror because they had all dreamed simultaneously of hearing a gun go off in the distance. In the morning the animals came out of their stalls to find that the flagstaff had been blown down and an elm tree at the foot of the orchard had been plucked up like a radish. They had just noticed this when a cry of despair broke from every animal's throat. A terrible sight had met their eyes. The windmill was in ruins.
paras.uz: Noyabr g'azabli janubi-g'arbiy shamollar bilan keldi. Qurilishni to'xtatishga to'g'ri keldi, chunki endi sement qorish uchun havo juda nam edi. Nihoyat shunday bir kecha keldiki, bo'ron shunchalik shiddatli ediki, ferma binolari poydevorlarida tebrandi va molxona tomidan bir nechta cherepitsa uchib ketdi. Tovuqlar dahshatdan qaqaglab uyg'onib ketishdi, chunki hammasi bir vaqtda uzoqda miltiq otilganini eshitgandek tush ko'rishgan edi. Ertalab hayvonlar qo'ralaridan chiqib, bayroq ustunini shamol qulatganini va bog' etagidagi qayrag'och turpdek sug'urib olinganini ko'rishdi. Ular buni endigina payqagan ediki, har bir hayvonning tomog'idan umidsizlik faryodi otilib chiqdi. Ko'zlari oldida dahshatli manzara turardi. Shamol tegirmoni vayron bo'lgan edi.

paras.en: With one accord they dashed down to the spot. Napoleon, who seldom moved out of a walk, raced ahead of them all. Yes, there it lay, the fruit of all their struggles, levelled to its foundations, the stones they had broken and carried so laboriously scattered all around. Unable at first to speak, they stood gazing mournfully at the litter of fallen stone. Napoleon paced to and fro in silence, occasionally snuffing at the ground. His tail had grown rigid and twitched sharply from side to side, a sign in him of intense mental activity. Suddenly he halted as though his mind were made up.
paras.uz: Ular bir ovozdan o'sha joyga yugurishdi. Kamdan-kam hollarda sekin yurishdan tezlashadigan Napoleon hammadan oldinda chopib bordi. Ha, ana u yotardi — barcha kurashlarining mevasi, poydevorigacha yer bilan yakson qilingan, ular shunchalik mashaqqat bilan sindirgan va tashigan toshlar atrofga sochilib yotardi. Dastlab gapira olmay, ular qulagan toshlar uyumiga g'amgin tikilib turishdi. Napoleon jimgina u yoqdan-bu yoqqa yurar, vaqti-vaqti bilan yerni hidlab qo'yardi. Uning dumi qotib qolgan va keskin u yoqdan-bu yoqqa tipirlardi — bu unda kuchli aqliy faoliyat belgisi edi. Birdan u go'yo qaror qilgandek to'xtadi.

paras.en: ‘Comrades,’ he said quietly, ‘do you know who is responsible for this? Do you know the enemy who has come in the night and overthrown our windmill? SNOWBALL!’ he suddenly roared in a voice of thunder, ‘Snowball has done this thing! In sheer malignity, thinking to set back our plans and avenge himself for his ignominious expulsion, this traitor has crept here under cover of night and destroyed our work of nearly a year. Comrades, here and now I pronounce the death sentence upon Snowball. “Animal Hero, Second Class”, and half a bushel of apples to any animal who brings him to justice. A full bushel to anyone who captures him alive!’
paras.uz: «O'rtoqlar, — dedi u jimgina, — buning uchun kim javobgar ekanini bilasizlarmi? Kechasi kelib, shamol tegirmonimizni qulatgan dushmanni bilasizlarmi? SNOUBOL! — deb birdan momaqaldiroqdek ovozda o'kirdi u. — Buni Snoubol qildi! Sof yovuzlik bilan, rejalarimizni orqaga surib, sharmandali haydalgani uchun o'ch olmoqchi bo'lib, bu xoin tun pardasi ostida bu yerga o'rmalab kelib, deyarli bir yillik mehnatimizni vayron qildi. O'rtoqlar, shu yerda va hozir Snoubolga o'lim hukmini e'lon qilaman. Uni javobgarlikka tortgan har qanday hayvonga — «Ikkinchi darajali Hayvon Qahramoni» va yarim bushel olma. Uni tirik qo'lga olganga — butun bir bushel!»

paras.en: The animals were shocked beyond measure to learn that even Snowball could be guilty of such an action. There was a cry of indignation, and everyone began thinking out ways of catching Snowball if he should ever come back. Almost immediately the footprints of a pig were discovered in the grass at a little distance from the knoll. They could only be traced for a few yards, but appeared to lead to a hole in the hedge. Napoleon snuffed deeply at them and pronounced them to be Snowball's. He gave it as his opinion that Snowball had probably come from the direction of Foxwood Farm.
paras.uz: Hatto Snoubol ham bunday ishda aybdor bo'lishi mumkinligini bilib, hayvonlar o'lchovsiz larzaga tushishdi. G'azab hayqirig'i ko'tarildi va har kim agar Snoubol qachondir qaytib kelsa, uni ushlash yo'llarini o'ylay boshladi. Deyarli darhol tepalikdan sal narida o't ichida cho'chqa izlari topildi. Ularni faqat bir necha yard kuzatish mumkin edi, lekin ular to'siqdagi teshikka olib borganga o'xshardi. Napoleon ularni chuqur hidlab, Snoubolniki deb e'lon qildi. Uning fikricha, Snoubol, ehtimol, Foksvud fermasi tomondan kelgan.

paras.en: ‘No more delays, comrades!’ cried Napoleon when the footprints had been examined. ‘There is work to be done. This very morning we begin rebuilding the windmill, and we will build all through the winter, rain or shine. We will teach this miserable traitor that he cannot undo our work so easily. Remember, comrades, there must be no alteration in our plans: they shall be carried out to the day. Forward, comrades! Long live the windmill! Long live Animal Farm!’
paras.uz: «Boshqa kechikish yo'q, o'rtoqlar! — deb qichqirdi Napoleon izlar tekshirilgach. — Qilinadigan ish bor. Shu bugun ertalab shamol tegirmonini qayta qurishni boshlaymiz va yomg'ir bo'ladimi, quyosh bo'ladimi, butun qish bo'yi quramiz. Bu bechora xoinga ishimizni bunchalik oson buzib bo'lmasligini o'rgatib qo'yamiz. Unutmang, o'rtoqlar, rejalarimizda hech qanday o'zgarish bo'lmasligi kerak: ular kunma-kun bajariladi. Oldinga, o'rtoqlar! Yashasin shamol tegirmoni! Yashasin Hayvonlar fermasi!»

quiz.q: Whom does Napoleon blame for the fall of the windmill?

chapters.recap_uz: Hayvonlar quldek ishlaydi. Napoleon insonlar bilan savdoni boshlaydi; cho'chqalar ferma uyiga ko'chib, karavotlarda uxlaydi — Amr esa «choyshabli karavot» deb o'zgarib qolgan. Bo'ronda tegirmon qulaydi va Napoleon aybni Snoubolga to'nkaydi.

chapters.title: Confessions and executions

paras.en: It was a bitter winter. The stormy weather was followed by sleet and snow, and then by a hard frost which did not break till well into February. The animals carried on as best they could with the rebuilding of the windmill, well knowing that the outside world was watching them and that the envious human beings would rejoice and triumph if the mill were not finished on time.
paras.uz: Qish qahraton bo'ldi. Bo'ronli havodan keyin qor aralash yomg'ir va qor yog'di, keyin esa fevralning ancha o'rtasigacha bo'shashmagan qattiq ayoz boshlandi. Hayvonlar tashqi dunyo ularni kuzatib turganini va agar tegirmon o'z vaqtida tugallanmasa, hasadgo'y insonlar quvonib, g'alaba nashidasini surishini yaxshi bilgan holda, shamol tegirmonini qayta qurishni qo'llaridan kelganicha davom ettirishdi.

paras.en: Out of spite, the human beings pretended not to believe that it was Snowball who had destroyed the windmill: they said that it had fallen down because the walls were too thin. The animals knew that this was not the case. Still, it had been decided to build the walls three feet thick this time instead of eighteen inches as before, which meant collecting much larger quantities of stone. For a long time the quarry was full of snowdrifts and nothing could be done. Some progress was made in the dry frosty weather that followed, but it was cruel work, and the animals could not feel so hopeful about it as they had felt before. They were always cold, and usually hungry as well. Only Boxer and Clover never lost heart. Squealer made excellent speeches on the joy of service and the dignity of labour, but the other animals found more inspiration in Boxer's strength and his never-failing cry of ‘I will work harder!’
paras.uz: Insonlar o'chakishib, shamol tegirmonini Snoubol buzganiga ishonmagandek ko'rsatishdi: ular tegirmon devorlari juda yupqa bo'lgani uchun qulagan, deyishdi. Hayvonlar bunday emasligini bilishardi. Shunday bo'lsa ham, bu safar devorlarni avvalgidek o'n sakkiz dyuym emas, uch fut qalinlikda qurishga qaror qilingan edi, bu esa ancha ko'p tosh yig'ishni anglatardi. Uzoq vaqt kon qor uyumlariga to'lib yotdi va hech narsa qilib bo'lmadi. Keyin kelgan quruq ayozli havoda biroz oldinga siljildi, lekin bu shafqatsiz mehnat edi va hayvonlar bu ishga avvalgidek umid bilan qaray olmasdilar. Ular doim sovqotar, odatda och ham edilar. Faqat Bokser va Klover hech qachon ruhan tushmadi. Skviler xizmat quvonchi va mehnat qadri haqida ajoyib nutqlar so'zlardi, lekin boshqa hayvonlar Bokserning kuchidan va uning hech qachon so'nmaydigan «Men yanada ko'proq ishlayman!» hayqirig'idan ko'proq ilhom olishardi.

paras.en: In January food fell short. The corn ration was drastically reduced, and it was announced that an extra potato ration would be issued to make up for it. Then it was discovered that the greater part of the potato crop had been frosted in the clamps, which had not been covered thickly enough. The potatoes had become soft and discoloured, and only a few were edible. For days at a time the animals had nothing to eat but chaff and mangels. Starvation seemed to stare them in the face.
paras.uz: Yanvarda oziq-ovqat yetishmay qoldi. Don ulushi keskin kamaytirildi va uning o'rnini to'ldirish uchun qo'shimcha kartoshka ulushi beriladi, deb e'lon qilindi. Keyin kartoshka hosilining katta qismi yetarlicha qalin yopilmagan o'ralarda muzlab qolgani ma'lum bo'ldi. Kartoshkalar yumshab, rangi o'zgarib ketgan edi, faqat bir nechtasini yeyish mumkin edi. Kunlab hayvonlarning somon to'pponi va xashaki lavlagidan boshqa yeydigan narsasi bo'lmadi. Ochlik ularning ko'ziga tik qarab turgandek edi.

paras.en: It was vitally necessary to conceal this fact from the outside world. Emboldened by the collapse of the windmill, the human beings were inventing fresh lies about Animal Farm. Once again it was being put about that all the animals were dying of famine and disease, and that they were continually fighting among themselves and had resorted to cannibalism and infanticide. Napoleon was well aware of the bad results that might follow if the real facts of the food situation were known, and he decided to make use of Mr Whymper to spread a contrary impression. Hitherto the animals had had little or no contact with Whymper on his weekly visits: now, however, a few selected animals, mostly sheep, were instructed to remark casually in his hearing that rations had been increased.
paras.uz: Bu faktni tashqi dunyodan yashirish hayotiy zarur edi. Shamol tegirmonining qulashidan ruhlangan insonlar Hayvonlar fermasi haqida yangi yolg'onlar to'qishardi. Yana barcha hayvonlar ochlik va kasallikdan o'layotgani, doimo o'zaro urishayotgani, bir-birini yeyish va bolalarini o'ldirishgacha borgani haqida gaplar tarqatilardi. Napoleon oziq-ovqat ahvoli haqidagi haqiqiy faktlar ma'lum bo'lsa, qanday yomon oqibatlar kelib chiqishi mumkinligini yaxshi bilardi va qarama-qarshi taassurot tarqatish uchun janob Uimperdan foydalanishga qaror qildi. Shu paytgacha hayvonlar Uimperning haftalik tashriflarida u bilan deyarli hech qanday aloqa qilmagan edi: endi esa bir nechta tanlangan hayvonga, asosan qo'ylarga, uning eshitishida go'yo tasodifan ulushlar ko'paytirilgani haqida gapirib qo'yish buyurildi.

paras.en: In addition, Napoleon ordered the almost empty bins in the store-shed to be filled nearly to the brim with sand, which was then covered up with what remained of the grain and meal. On some suitable pretext Whymper was led through the store-shed and allowed to catch a glimpse of the bins. He was deceived, and continued to report to the outside world that there was no food shortage on Animal Farm.
paras.uz: Bundan tashqari, Napoleon omborxonadagi deyarli bo'sh qutilarni deyarli lim-limigacha qum bilan to'ldirishni, keyin ularni qolgan don va un bilan yopib qo'yishni buyurdi. Qandaydir munosib bahona bilan Uimper omborxona orqali olib o'tildi va unga qutilarni bir ko'z tashlab ko'rishga imkon berildi. U aldandi va tashqi dunyoga Hayvonlar fermasida oziq-ovqat tanqisligi yo'qligi haqida xabar berishda davom etdi.

paras.en: Nevertheless, towards the end of January it became obvious that it would be necessary to procure some more grain from somewhere. In these days Napoleon rarely appeared in public, but spent all his time in the farmhouse, which was guarded at each door by fierce-looking dogs. When he did emerge it was in a ceremonial manner, with an escort of six dogs who closely surrounded him and growled if anyone came too near. Frequently he did not even appear on Sunday mornings, but issued his orders through one of the other pigs, usually Squealer.
paras.uz: Shunga qaramay, yanvar oxiriga kelib qayerdandir yana don olish zarurligi ayon bo'ldi. Bu kunlarda Napoleon kamdan-kam hollarda ko'pchilik oldida ko'rinar, butun vaqtini har bir eshigini yovuz ko'rinishli itlar qo'riqlaydigan ferma uyida o'tkazardi. U tashqariga chiqqanida ham tantanali tarzda, uni zich o'rab olgan va kimdir juda yaqin kelsa irillaydigan oltita it hamrohligida chiqardi. Ko'pincha u hatto yakshanba ertalab ham ko'rinmas, buyruqlarini boshqa cho'chqalardan biri, odatda Skviler orqali berardi.

paras.en: One Sunday morning Squealer announced that the hens, who had just come in to lay again, must surrender their eggs. Napoleon had accepted, through Whymper, a contract for four hundred eggs a week. The price of these would pay for enough grain and meal to keep the farm going till summer came on and conditions were easier.
paras.uz: Bir yakshanba ertalab Skviler endigina yana tuxum qo'ya boshlagan tovuqlar tuxumlarini topshirishlari kerakligini e'lon qildi. Napoleon Uimper orqali haftasiga to'rt yuzta tuxum yetkazib berish shartnomasini qabul qilgan ekan. Ularning puli yoz kelib, sharoit yengillashguncha fermani ushlab turish uchun yetarli don va unga to'lanadi.

paras.en: When the hens heard this they raised a terrible outcry. They had been warned earlier that this sacrifice might be necessary, but had not believed that it would really happen. They were just getting their clutches ready for the spring sitting, and they protested that to take the eggs away now was murder. For the first time since the expulsion of Jones there was something resembling a rebellion. Led by three young Black Minorca pullets, the hens made a determined effort to thwart Napoleon's wishes. Their method was to fly up to the rafters and there lay their eggs, which smashed to pieces on the floor. Napoleon acted swiftly and ruthlessly. He ordered the hens’ rations to be stopped, and decreed that any animal giving so much as a grain of corn to a hen should be punished by death.
paras.uz: Tovuqlar buni eshitib, dahshatli shovqin ko'tarishdi. Ularni ilgari bunday qurbonlik zarur bo'lishi mumkinligi haqida ogohlantirishgan edi, lekin ular bu haqiqatan ham sodir bo'lishiga ishonishmagan edi. Ular endigina bahorgi bosib yotish uchun tuxumlarini tayyorlayotgan edi va hozir tuxumlarni olib qo'yish qotillik, deb norozilik bildirishdi. Jons haydalganidan beri birinchi marta qo'zg'olonga o'xshash narsa yuz berdi.
